entries.question: Book appointment
entries.answer:
To book an appointment at KGMU, you have the following options:

*   **Online Portal (ORS):** Visit [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in). Select "Uttar Pradesh" as the state and "King George's Medical University" as the hospital. You can then select your department, date, and time slot.
*   **Mobile App:** Download the **ABHA** or **Health Care** app from the KGMU Play Store, register with your mobile number, and follow the same booking process as the ORS portal.
*   **SMS Booking:** Send an SMS with the text "APPOINTMENT [Patient Name]" to **8887019134**.
*   **Walk-in:** You can visit the registration counters on-site. Please bring the patient's **Aadhaar card** and an active mobile number to receive the OTP.

**Important Information:**
*   **Registration Fee:** A flat fee of ₹50 is charged for the OPD slip (applicable to all booking methods).
*   **Timings:** The registration counters are open Monday–Friday from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM and Saturday from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM (Closed on Sundays).
*   **Referrals:** Patients from outside the city must bring a valid referral for their specific department.
*   **Pre-booking:** It is strongly recommended to book in advance to avoid long wait times.

I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline at **0522-2258880** / **0522-3539333**. Also, please avoid sharing personal details (like Aadhaar numbers or phone numbers) in this chat for your safety.

entries.question: मैं ललितपुर उत्तर प्रदेश से हूं मुझे आपकी कॉलेज में ओटीटी के लिए एडमिशन लेना है कैसे लें
entries.answer:
किंग जॉर्ज चिकित्सा विश्वविद्यालय (KGMU) में प्रवेश संबंधी जानकारी के लिए आप आधिकारिक वेबसाइट [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) पर देख सकते हैं।

चूँकि आप उत्तर प्रदेश के ललितपुर से हैं, कृपया ध्यान दें कि KGMU में विभिन्न पाठ्यक्रमों के लिए प्रवेश परीक्षा आयोजित की जाती है। 'ओटीटी' (Operation Theatre Technology) जैसे पाठ्यक्रमों के लिए प्रवेश प्रक्रिया, पात्रता और आवेदन तिथियों की नवीनतम जानकारी आप यहाँ देख सकते हैं: [https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php)

मैं आपको सलाह दूँगा कि आप समय-समय पर वेबसाइट के 'Admission' सेक्शन को चेक करते रहें, ताकि आप आवेदन की प्रक्रिया न चूकें।

**महत्वपूर्ण:** मैं एक एआई सहायक हूँ जिसे डॉ. आयुष यादव द्वारा बनाया गया है। मैं किसी भी प्रकार की मेडिकल सलाह नहीं दे सकता। यदि आप किसी स्वास्थ्य समस्या के लिए इलाज हेतु आना चाहते हैं, तो कृपया KGMU की ओपीडी (OPD) के लिए ऑनलाइन अपॉइंटमेंट लें या [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in) का उपयोग करें। कृपया इस चैट में अपना आधार नंबर या अन्य संवेदनशील व्यक्तिगत जानकारी साझा न करें।

2. **नोटिफिकेशन:** फॉर्म भरने से पहले उस विशेष कोर्स का 'Information Brochure' जरूर डाउनलोड करें और उसे ध्यान से पढ़ें।
3. **सुरक्षा:** अपना पासवर्ड, आधार नंबर, या भुगतान संबंधी जानकारी किसी भी अनजान व्यक्ति या अनौपचारिक वेबसाइट के साथ साझा न करें।

यदि आपको फॉर्म भरने में तकनीकी समस्या आती है, तो आप वेबसाइट पर दिए गए आधिकारिक हेल्पलाइन नंबरों या ईमेल पर संपर्क कर सकते हैं।

entries.question: Eligibility to become a physics assistant professor in kgmu
entries.answer:
To be eligible for an Assistant Professor position at King George's Medical University (KGMU), please note that KGMU is a medical university. Most faculty positions are in medical, dental, or allied health sciences (such as Anatomy, Physiology, Biochemistry, etc.).

There is no "Department of Physics" at KGMU in the traditional academic sense. However, if you are referring to **Medical Physics** (Radiotherapy/Radiodiagnosis departments), the eligibility typically follows the standards set by the Atomic Energy Regulatory Board (AERB) and the National Medical Commission (NMC):

### Typical Eligibility for a Medical Physics Faculty Role:
1.  **Educational Qualification:**
    *   **M.Sc. in Medical Physics** or M.Sc. in Physics with a Diploma in Radiological Physics (DRP) from a recognized university/institution.
    *   A Ph.D. in the relevant field is often preferred or required for Assistant Professor positions.
2.  **Experience:**
    *   Relevant teaching or clinical experience in a hospital-based medical physics setup.
    *   Registration/Certification as a Radiological Safety Officer (RSO) is often a mandatory requirement for clinical faculty in departments like Radiotherapy.
3.  **National Standards:**
    *   Candidates must generally meet the criteria laid down by the **National Medical Commission (NMC)** for medical institutions.

### Important Clarification:
*   **Vacancies:** KGMU only hires for positions when a vacancy is officially notified. You can monitor the [KGMU Careers/Recruitment page](https://www.kgmu.org/jobs.php) for any active advertisements.
*   **Verification:** Because requirements can change based on the specific department (e.g., Radiotherapy vs. Nuclear Medicine), I strongly recommend checking the [KGMU Faculty Directory](https://www.kgmu.org/department.php) to see which departments currently have Medical Physicists and what their qualifications are.

If you are looking for a general physics teaching position (non-medical), KGMU is likely not the appropriate institution, as it focuses exclusively on medical and health science education.

entries.question: Physics Assistant professor job profile
entries.answer:
At King George's Medical University (KGMU), a **Medical Physicist** (often serving in a faculty capacity within departments like **Radiotherapy, Radiodiagnosis, or Nuclear Medicine**) performs a role that bridges clinical patient care, research, and teaching.

Unlike a traditional college physics professor, the job profile at a medical university is highly clinical and technical.

### 1. Clinical Responsibilities (Patient Care)
*   **Treatment Planning:** Designing complex radiation dose distributions for cancer patients using specialized software (e.g., for Linac/Brachytherapy).
*   **Quality Assurance (QA):** Performing rigorous daily, weekly, and monthly testing of sophisticated medical equipment (Linear Accelerators, CT simulators, etc.) to ensure patient safety and accuracy.
*   **Radiation Safety:** Acting as a **Radiological Safety Officer (RSO)** to monitor radiation levels, ensure compliance with Atomic Energy Regulatory Board (AERB) guidelines, and protect staff and patients from unnecessary exposure.
*   **Dosimetry:** Conducting precise measurements to verify that the radiation dose delivered matches the prescribed plan.

### 2. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities
*   **Student Training:** Teaching medical students (MBBS) and postgraduate residents (MD/DNB in Radiotherapy/Radiology) about the physics of radiation, imaging, and safety.
*   **Mentorship:** Guiding students pursuing M.Sc. in Medical Physics or DRP (Diploma in Radiological Physics) during their clinical internships.
*   **Curriculum Development:** Assisting in updating the academic modules regarding medical imaging and radiation physics.

### 3. Research & Development
*   **Clinical Research:** Conducting research on new radiation delivery techniques, advanced imaging modalities, or dose-optimization strategies to improve patient outcomes.
*   **Publications:** Publishing findings in peer-reviewed medical and physics journals.
*   **Collaboration:** Working closely with Oncologists, Radiologists, and Surgeons to implement new clinical technologies.

### 4. Administrative & Regulatory
*   **Compliance:** Maintaining records for regulatory bodies (AERB/NMC).
*   **Equipment Procurement:** Providing technical expertise during the acquisition and installation of new high-end medical equipment.

### Summary of the Role
*   **Work Environment:** Primarily hospital-based (Radiotherapy/Radiology departments).
*   **Key Skills Required:** Expert knowledge of ionizing radiation, clinical dosimetry, medical imaging physics, and AERB safety protocols.
*   **Primary Difference:** You are not teaching "General Physics" (Mechanics, Optics, etc.); you are applying physics principles to save lives in a clinical oncology or diagnostic setting.

**Note:** As a reminder, I am a chatbot created by **Dr. Ayush Yadav** to assist with information regarding KGMU. For specific job openings or current faculty requirements, please keep an eye on the official [KGMU Recruitment Page](https://www.kgmu.org/jobs.php).

entries.question: Salary of assistant professor in kgmu
entries.answer:
The salary of an Assistant Professor at King George's Medical University (KGMU) is governed by the pay scales prescribed by the **Uttar Pradesh State Government** and aligns with the **7th Central Pay Commission (CPC)** recommendations.

### Salary Structure
*   **Pay Level:** Assistant Professors are generally placed in **Academic Level 12** of the 7th CPC pay matrix.
*   **Basic Pay:** The starting Basic Pay is typically **₹1,01,500** per month.
*   **Allowances:** In addition to the Basic Pay, faculty members are entitled to various allowances as per state government rules, which include:
    *   **Dearness Allowance (DA):** A percentage of the basic pay, adjusted periodically based on inflation.
    *   **House Rent Allowance (HRA):** Varies based on the city of posting (Lucknow, in this case).
    *   **Transport Allowance (TA):** Provided as per government norms.
    *   **Other Allowances:** Depending on the specific role and department, there may be additional academic or clinical allowances.

### Gross Monthly Salary
The total monthly emoluments (Gross Salary) for an Assistant Professor at KGMU typically range between **₹1,40,000 to ₹1,60,000** (depending on the current DA rate and specific city-based allowances).

### Important Considerations:
1.  **Deductions:** The net (take-home) salary will be lower after mandatory deductions such as the National Pension System (NPS) contribution, Professional Tax, and Income Tax.
2.  **Variations:** The exact figures can vary based on the specific government orders issued by the Government of Uttar Pradesh at the time of appointment.
3.  **Official Verification:** For precise details regarding a specific position, you should refer to the **official recruitment notification** (advertisement) released by KGMU for that post, as it explicitly states the pay scale and grade pay applicable at that time.

You can monitor official job notifications on the [KGMU Jobs/Recruitment page](https://www.kgmu.org/jobs.php) to see the exact pay scale mentioned in recent advertisements.
